newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil seen cautious, awaits export data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil seen cautious, awaits export data.

text.p: Malaysian palm oil prices are expected to open little changed in cautious trading with lower soyoil prices in Chicago seen having a slight impact.
The market is awaiting the release of June 1-25 export data due later today.
Traders said the market will remain rangebound.
* Sept closed on Tuesday at 1,202 ringgit
* "Today's market depends a lot on the outcome of the June 1-25 palm oil exports," a trader said. "If the export data is supportive, then we will see September move above the 1,200 ringgit level."
* If the data is within market expectations, prices will trade within tight ranges and wait for other leads.

* Traders said sellers were reluctant to enter the market for fear that prices will rise on expectation of fresh demand in the physical crude palm oil and products. An Egyptian tender today could also underpin sentiment.
